name: voidloopsstudio
description: A node-based DAW: the project is a Void Core mantle drawn as a dataflow graph on Void Maiz, and the host computes the audio. Native C++20 shell in native/; the Python prototype in voidloops/ is the reference implementation.

requires.name: voidcore
requires.note: the model and the dispatcher. The native shell reaches it through Void Maiz's add_subdirectory, which links the prebuilt libvoidcore.dll that ships beside vls_native.exe. The Python reference implementation (voidloops/) imports the editable voidcore package from the same checkout. The floor is Void Maiz's.

requires.name: voidmaiz
requires.note: the canvas, inspector, faces and widget protocol of the native shell (voidmaiz, voidmaiz_view), compiled in with add_subdirectory. Headless and voidmaiz_net are not adopted yet.

requires.name: voidallomone
requires.note: not used directly; compiled into Void Maiz, so a change to it is a rebuild here.
